secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with Actions read/write on the runner repository. Create it at https://github.com/settings/tokens?type=beta

secrets.name: BUILDER_OWNER
secrets.description: Owner (user or org) of the runner repository that holds .github/workflows/desktop-build.yml. A bare name or a pasted https://github.com/OWNER/REPO URL both work.

secrets.name: BUILDER_REPO
secrets.description: Name of the runner repository that holds the desktop-build.yml workflow
